title: Novell NetIQ Access Manager FwRequest Unrestricted File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Novell NetIQ Access Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FwRequest class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow for the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this to execute code in the context of the current process.
